get.description: Magnus-managed Ardent profiles. When Magnus is unavailable the list is empty and magnus.state says so.

Persisted events carry their seq as the SSE id and replay after ?after=. reset means the cursor is older than retained events (or ahead of them): refetch the snapshot. heartbeat every 15 s. The stream closes when the token expires or its session ends; reconnect with a fresh token.
